Main finding 2: Main actually read all24 cited ranges913distinct lines from12 fixed entries, including six complete declarations SonicBoom, Behavior, WardenAi, ExpirableValue, StopAttackingIfTargetInvalid and MeleeAttack. Remaining containing classes are bounded partials. Inherited or generic helpers are not new credit. All raw keepends/normalized excerpt/private-copy/archive bindings independently verified.
Main finding 3: Warden EntityType constructor and makeBrain delegate establish local provenance. Full WardenAi registers memories/sensors, initializes core/default and specialized activities; Fight requires ATTACK_TARGET and erases it on exit. Ordered priorities place invalid-target behavior, look/walk, Sonic then Melee; source construction is not current loaded-pack execution.
Main finding 4: Sonic entry requires target present, sonic cooldown absent and two sound memories REGISTERED. REGISTERED means registered slot, not absence or permission. Extra distance uses strict XZ radius15 and vertical difference20, not a sphere or inclusive boundary. Own start condition has no line-of-sight ray test; upstream target selection remains a boundary.
Main finding 5: Behavior.tryStart checks entry memories/extra once, sets RUNNING and endTimestamp from current gameTime plus random duration with equal60 bounds, then start. Later tickOrStop uses strict gameTime>endTimestamp and canStillUse, which Sonic returns true. It does not automatically repeat entry memory predicates each tick or capture a target identity.
Main finding 6: Sonic.start sets ATTACK_COOLING_DOWN trueTTL60 and SOUND_DELAY UnitTTL34, then event62 and charge sound. These requests precede release and do not prove eligible victim, damage, accepted control or paid acquisition. No immutable victim/attempt identifier is stored by this class.
Main finding 7: Brain starts STOPPED behaviors only IN ACTIVE eligible activities, then ticks all RUNNING behaviors without that active filter. This is the explicit corrected interpretation of original concatenated in+active wording; original observation retained plus additive clarification. setActiveActivity erases configured other-activity memories but does not itself stop behaviors. Explicit stopAll does call doStop.
Main finding 8: Brain forgetOutdatedMemories precedes sensors/start/run, checks hasExpired before decrementing; ExpirableValue expires at<=0, decrements finite rawlong TTL, MAX_VALUE stays infinite. Setter/getter/checkMemory do not themselves remove expired entries; decrement to0 remains until a subsequent sweep. These update clocks differ from Behavior gameTime, so exact walltime or universal off-by-one behavior is unproved.
Main finding 9: At release, both sound delay and sound cooldown must be absent. Sonic writes SOUND_COOLDOWN TTL26 BEFORE current ATTACK_TARGET retrieval/filter. No eligible current target can therefore consume the normal opportunity without particles/damage. It is a local release latch, not payment, conserved ammunition, refund, irrevocable global once-only transaction or guaranteed shot.
Main finding 10: Current target is re-read after warmup and validated by Warden.canTargetEntity and strict distance: same level, native no creative/spectator predicate, not allied/armorstand/Warden/invulnerable/dead-or-dying, world-border bounding box. It need not be the starting target. Selector, alliance, border and subclass internals are not fully expanded; no global Boss-control predicate claim.
Main finding 11: Qualified ray requests particles from emitter+y(double)1.6F toward current victim eyes, with normalized direction and i=1..<floor(length)+7, then boom sound. Own method does not block-raycast. Source geometry is not an admitted physical projectile, guaranteed wall penetration, drawn pixels, audible output or terrain-wide hit proof.
Main finding 12: hurt(sonicBoom(emitter),10) Boolean is ignored; on ordinary return KBR then push follows, even if hurt returns false. Base Entity.push adds deltaMovement and sets impulse, not actual displacement/setPos. KBR-dependent requests and parent hurt engine are not an independent new credit or native accepted damage/knockback test.
Main finding 13: Sonic.stop sets only SONIC_BOOM_COOLDOWN40; it does not clear all attack/sound memories, refund a spent release or issue a victim-specific failure receipt. Warden.setAttackTarget writes target and cooldown200, and doHurtTarget writes cooldown40 before parent result. Shared memory can be changed by other actions; not a private per-target escrow.
Main finding 14: Whole MeleeAttack requires attack-cooling absent/target/nearest-visible, tests range and usable projectile weapon, then swing/doHurtTarget and cooldown18 without conditioning on damage Boolean. Sonic60 memory can suppress this local branch, not every attack caller. StopAttackingIfTargetInvalid can erase target after predicate/callback; Warden false flag disables its tired-reach check, not all invalidation.
Main finding 15: Warden server step ticks Brain before parent AI/darkness/anger/updateActivity. Event62 starts its own sonic animation state at current client tick; that own cue carries no immutable victim ID. Source call order is not two-client packet/order/owner identity, rendered clip lifetime or denial-feedback acceptance.

No own Sonic/Behavior IO and partial Brain codec exploration do not prove all sound memory transient, complete in-flight restoration or absent hidden state. Migration credit remains0.
